title: Wildly Spicy Chicken Tacos
description: A spicy twist on traditional tacos, featuring crispy chicken and a bold mix of spices.
instructions: Season the chicken with cumin, chili powder, and salt.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to the oven and cook until cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
While the chicken cooks, heat the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
In a separate pan, heat the diced chipotle peppers in adobo sauce over medium heat.
Add the sliced jalepeno peppers to the pan and cook until slightly softened, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the chopped wild onions to the pan and cook until slightly softened, about 2-3 minutes.
Shred the cooked chicken and add it to the pan with the onion and pepper mixture.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the chicken and pepper mixture onto a tortilla, topping with shredded cheese if desired.
